scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:community-market && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck:product: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/paif-web typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/paif-mobile typecheck
scripts.validate:product: pnpm run typecheck:product && pnpm run test && pnpm --filter @workspace/paif-mobile test && pnpm run test:community-market
scripts.validate: pnpm run check && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:community-market
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
